Another great tune from Andy Morrow who got this from Tom McElvogue who got it from his flute teacher Pat Knight who got it from the playing of Davey Arthur. Its all in the CD cover so buy the CD…..You wont regret it.

Re: The Thrush In The Storm

I have since caught up with Patrick Knight and he has asked me to clarify that this was actually learned by him from the setting in Ceol Rincena hEireann Volume 1:

167. An Smólach sa Stoirm [The Thrush in the Storm]
[from John Brennan, flute]

Hope that helps in the discussion!
